acts: FDA prescribing information published on DailyMed

en.title: glycopyrrolate oral solution: Table 1, 18 to 22 kg, Dose Level 2 has no instruction for a patient the label covers
en.summary: Table 1, 18 to 22 kg, Dose Level 2 reads “0.8 mL”. Example: The cell sits in the milligram column. Read as printed, 0.8 mL of a 1 mg/5 mL solution is 0.16 mg, while the volume column of the same row gives 4 mL. The same text is in 5 labels from 5 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.

ai_role.en: AI agents read the labels, compared their parts and, where marked, ran the example patient through executable rules; an AI agent then read each place in full, with tables and footnotes, and confirmed it. No clinician has assessed these places. A person at Arxo approved publication (2026-10-31).
